name: Stone Shape

targets.description: a Medium or smaller stone object, or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension

summary: Reshape a Medium or smaller stone object, or a section of stone up to 5 ft in any dimension.
text: You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller, or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension, and mold it into any shape you like. You could, for example, carve a boulder into a statue or a crude club, open a gap in a wall up to 5 feet thick, or fuse a stone door to its frame. The object you make can have up to two hinges and a latch, but finer mechanical detail isn't possible.
